title: Dot product of joined binary blocks
statement: For any positive integer $n$ and vectors $a,b,x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the dot product over $\mathbb F_2$ of the concatenations of $a,b$ and $x,y$ is the sum of their blockwise dot products: $\langle(a,b),(x,y)\rangle=\langle a,x\rangle+\langle b,y\rangle$.
